pass_claimed_on: strict arm-only reading (A): both cameras >= 0.80 held-out; the real-occluder-excluded reading (B) is reported as well and also passes
masks: so101_twin/redlego/masks/redlego_<cam>_t1ok.npy: SAM 2.1 consensus-prompted (twin r1c silhouette + twin-independent DINO+SAM mask _d1k), real brick pixels removed (_t1o), thin cables removed by a 5x5 opening (_t1ok); occluders for reading B: redlego_<cam>_d1_occ.npy (brick | box, DINO+SAM on the real frames only)
occluder_masks: so101_twin/redlego/masks/redlego_<cam>_d1_occ.npy (red brick | cardboard box; real frames only)

wrist_camera_bar.frame: gripper body (so101 'gripper'), [x, y, z (m), rotvec (rad), length (m)]

wrist_camera_bar.source: global search bar_search.py + stage-C refinement against the arm masks, even episodes

base_cable_loop.frame: arm root (base) frame, [x, y, z (m), rotvec (rad), semi-axes (m)]
base_cable_loop.geometry: static ellipsoid (black cable loop at the foot of the base, side view)
base_cable_loop.source: global search blob_search.py against the arm masks, even episodes

mesh_comparison.rule: max mean over cameras of the EVEN-episode strict median

twin_independent_check.masks: so101_twin/redlego/masks/redlego_<cam>_d1k.npy (DINO+SAM box-prompted, brick/box removed, 5x5 opening; no twin input)

guard_rails.lens_note: all |k1| < 0.4 and principal-point shifts < 10 %: no lens audit required
guard_rails.joint_scales_note: fitted 0.95-1.18 deg/unit, consistent with LeRobot's normalised -100..100 mode (pan 1.18 deg/unit = ~236 deg calibrated travel); visual check at the extremes of every joint in so101_twin/redlego/out/extremes.jpg

fit_protocol: fit on EVEN episodes only (24 episodes, 192 frames); held_out = ODD episodes (16 episodes, 128 frames)
